lines.en: Nightmare power!
I roll my bulk toward you.
Fear reigns!
Prey's scent!
Hunter in the dark!
Choke the throat!
Shadow of the night!
The ground shakes along with me.
Taste of death!

lines.zh: 沉重的身躯压过梦魇石。
lines.en: My heavy body presses over nightmare stone.

lines.zh: 每走一步都在积蓄爆炸。
lines.en: Every step stores up another blast.

lines.zh: 第二层的走廊传来闷响。
lines.en: A dull thud rolls down the second floor corridor.
One blink, and the ground will shake.
Hidden in wait!
Waiting for prey!
Patient hunter!
Night's cover!
Silent approach!
Always ready!
Waiting for darkness!
Strike when ready!
Darkness is my strength!
Your scent!
Prey in sight!
My single eye has found you.
Feeling it!
Following your scent!
Close to prey!
I stare at you, feet already off the ground.

lines.zh: 这层楼里有活物的味道。
lines.en: Something alive is on this floor.
Feeling you!
Prey's smell!

lines.zh: 哀嚎一声，伤口流出血红色的液体。
lines.en: A mournful cry as blood flows from its wounds.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中充满了痛苦和绝望。
lines.en: Its cry is filled with pain and despair.

lines.zh: 身躯一颤，鲜红的血液染红了地面。
lines.en: Its body trembles as its blood stains the ground.

lines.zh: 发出一声凄厉的叫声，伤口不停滴血。
lines.en: A terrible cry, blood dripping from its wounds.

lines.zh: 痛苦地嘶叫着，伤口疼痛不已。
lines.en: It lets out a painful wail, its wounds throbbing.

lines.zh: 叫声中透露着挣扎与痛苦。
lines.en: Its cry shows its struggle and pain.

lines.zh: 挣扎着发出痛苦的叫声，血迹斑斑。
lines.en: It wails in pain, blood everywhere.

lines.zh: 一声凄厉的叫声，鲜血如泉涌出。
lines.en: A terrible cry, blood spilling like a fountain.

lines.zh: 伤口撕裂般的疼痛让它痛苦地叫喊。
lines.en: Pain from its wounds makes it wail in agony.

lines.zh: 痛苦的叫声中透露着生命的脆弱。
lines.en: Its cry shows the fragility of life in pain.

lines.zh: 它的眼眸闪烁着恶意的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with malice.

lines.zh: 小心！它的爪子锋利无比。
lines.en: Watch out! Its claws are razor-sharp.
It emerges from the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的吼声令人不寒而栗。
lines.en: Its roar sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 它对肉块有着极大的兴趣。
lines.en: It has a voracious appetite for meat.

lines.zh: 它栖息在黑暗的洞穴中。
lines.en: It dwells in dark caverns.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让人防不胜防。
lines.en: Its attacks are hard to predict.
It constantly seeks new prey.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤像岩石一样坚硬。
lines.en: Its skin is as hard as stone.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛似乎能看透黑暗。
lines.en: Its eyes seem to see through the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的身体沉重，难以抵挡。
lines.en: Its body is heavy, hard to resist.

lines.zh: 撞击后，它的速度更快了。
lines.en: After the impact, it speeds up.

lines.zh: 它的体型庞大，难以忽视。
lines.en: Its size is imposing.

lines.zh: 它在撞击中展示了力量。
lines.en: It showcased its power in the impact.

lines.zh: 它的跳跃带着毁灭的意味。
lines.en: Its jump carries a destructive meaning.

lines.zh: 它的力量几乎无处不在。
lines.en: Its power is omnipresent.

lines.zh: 它在战斗中展现出惊人的耐力。
lines.en: It displays remarkable stamina in combat.
Its movements are quick and powerful.

lines.zh: 它的冲击力让人难以招架。
lines.en: Its impact is hard to handle.

lines.zh: 它的力量足以震碎岩石。
lines.en: Its strength can shatter stone.

lines.zh: 它寻找着配偶，发出求偶的信号。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, emitting mating signals.

lines.zh: 它在夜晚独自发出求偶声。
lines.en: It calls for a mate at night alone.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声令人不安。
lines.en: Its mating call is unsettling.

lines.zh: 它对同类有着强烈的需求。
lines.en: It has a strong need for its own kind.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为充满侵略性。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is aggressive.

lines.zh: 它用爪子展示求偶意愿。
lines.en: It displays mating intentions with its claws.

lines.zh: 它在求偶时显得格外凶猛。
lines.en: It is exceptionally fierce when mating.

lines.zh: 它在夜晚求偶，难以忽视。
lines.en: It calls for a mate at night, impossible to ignore.
It attracts mates with its calls.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为充满危险。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is dangerous.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，猎物的味道真香！
lines.en: Sssss, yummy prey.
Feel the fear.
Don't run, I'm getting closer.
This is my territory.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你想象的更锐利！
lines.en: My eyes are sharper than you think.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的恐惧，将你撕碎！
lines.en: Devour your fear and rip you apart.

lines.zh: 我的爪子可以轻易碾碎你！
lines.en: My claws can crush you easily.

lines.zh: 梦魇的赠礼，你的死期到了！
lines.en: Nightmare's gift, your time is up.

lines.zh: 我是恐惧之眼，你逃不掉！
lines.en: I am Gorgosion, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 恐惧的种子在我心中生根发芽！
lines.en: Fear grows in my heart.
Prey's scent, getting closer.
I sense you, your smell.
A guest has come to the second layer.

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，尽情享受吧！
lines.en: Prey in sight, enjoy it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子就要碾碎你的心脏！
lines.en: My claws will crush your heart.
Fear will guide me to you.

lines.zh: 感受到你的恐惧在蔓延！
lines.en: I sense your fear spreading.
Lock, aim, fire fear.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，我就是你的死神！
lines.en: You can't escape, I am your death.

lines.zh: 恐惧与我同在，无处可逃！
lines.en: Fear is with me, nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，地面会炸。
lines.en: When I land, the ground bursts.
Only I walk this corridor.
I smell the sweat of the living.
My prey stands below the stone steps.
You stepped on a nightmare slab.
Target found. The leaping begins.

lines.zh: 我要让你尝尝我的利爪！
lines.en: I'll taste your claws.
Feel the fear, it's yours.

lines.zh: 恐惧之眼要看到你的死亡！
lines.en: Gorgosion sees your death.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧化为我的力量！
lines.en: Your fear is my strength.
Gorgosion watches you.
Fear is your only home.
You'll be devoured by Gorgosion.
Fear is your last struggle.
Gorgosion won't forgive you.
The flood of fear will drown you.

lines.zh: 我压低了身体，准备起跳。
lines.en: I lower my body, ready to jump.
I will land right beside your feet.

lines.zh: 这一跳不砸方块，只砸你。
lines.en: This jump breaks no blocks, only you.

lines.zh: 地面在颤抖，那是我的节奏。
lines.en: The ground shakes with my rhythm.

lines.zh: 爆炸的范围我算得很准。
lines.en: I have the blast radius measured.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，落地的爆炸不怕墙。
lines.en: I leap, and my landing blast ignores walls.
I leap, and the ground cracks.
Before I jump, I take one look at you.
On the second floor of the nightmare, there is no way back.

lines.zh: 数着你的脚步，等你停下。
lines.en: I count your steps and wait for you to stop.
Hiss, you have one breath left.
Move! I'm going to eat you!
Feel the fear!
This leap lands on your head.
My claws will rip you!
Feel the wrath of Gorgosion!
You're close to death!
Scream, you're going to die!
You can't hide, you can't escape!
Fear will consume you!
The landing shock knocks you over!
Up I leap, down I slam!
That one shattered even the stone!
The shockwave hits your ribs!
I land, and the ground blooms!
Higher jump, heavier blow!
The blast leaves you off balance!
Gravel flies with me!
My eye found the landing spot!
This blast is for you alone!
Sssssss from the darkness!
I'm here, Gorgosion!
Nightmare World, my territory!
Night falls, I will hunt!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的影子，我的猎物！
lines.en: Shadow in the dark, my prey!
Depth of nightmare, Gorgosion!
Welcome to my nightmare!
Night's breath, my breath!
The nightmare of fear awakens!
Gorgosion, I will appear!

lines.zh: 梦魇第二层的石板裂开了。
lines.en: The slabs of the nightmare's second floor split open.

lines.zh: 我落地时震塌了一段走廊。
lines.en: My landing collapsed a stretch of corridor.

lines.zh: 火焰灼烧着它的皮肤，痛苦地尖叫。
lines.en: The flames burn its skin, causing a painful scream.

lines.zh: 从高处摔落，它痛苦地哀嚎。
lines.en: It lets out a mournful cry after falling from a height.

lines.zh: 被水淹没时，它痛苦地挣扎。
lines.en: It struggles in the water, in pain.

lines.zh: 被爆炸击中，恐惧之眼痛苦地嘶叫。
lines.en: Hit by an explosion, it lets out a painful scream.

lines.zh: 被投射物击中，恐惧之眼痛苦地哀嚎。
lines.en: Hit by a projectile, it wails in pain.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击让它痛苦地尖叫。
lines.en: A magical attack causes it to scream in pain.

lines.zh: 因为饥饿，它虚弱地发出哀鸣。
lines.en: It lets out a weak, mournful cry due to hunger.
It lets out a painful scream from the lightning strike.

lines.zh: 坠入虚空中，恐惧之眼绝望地叫喊。
lines.en: It lets out a despairing cry as it falls into the void.
